zh.summary: 把「幫我做一個系統」改寫為有角色、困難、時機與成功證據的問題陳述，為後續規格保留清楚的範圍。
objectives: 從解法要求中找出尚未被理解的工作問題。
寫出可觀察、保留不確定性的問題陳述。
產出能交給同儕檢查的 problem.md 初稿。

sections.heading: 先搞清楚遇到什麼問題
paragraphs: 不要一聽到別人說想做什麼系統，就立刻開始設計系統。要先搞清楚他究竟遇到了什麼問題。有人說：「我想做一個 AI 系統，幫我們提高工作效率。」這句話聽起來像需求，但還沒有交代實際工作。
先問：誰的工作需要改善？他每天究竟在做什麼？哪個環節讓他感到困難？困難是什麼原因造成的？改善後怎麼知道真的有效？Problem Statement（問題陳述）把這些問題整理成團隊可以追問與驗證的說明。

sections.heading: 一、問題陳述就像醫生看診：先診斷，再開藥
paragraphs: 想像一位病人走進診間說：「醫生，我想要吃抗生素。」醫生如果立刻開藥，就還沒了解病人哪裡不舒服，也不知道是不是細菌感染。專業的醫生會先問：「你哪裡不舒服？什麼時候開始？有哪些症狀？嚴重程度如何？」這裡借用看診順序說明問題定義，並不提供個別醫療判斷。
軟體工程也一樣。「我要 AI 系統」表達對某種解決方案的期待，還需要釐清工作困難。最後可能發現，把原本混亂的表單與檢查規則整理好，就能改善問題。需求工程（Requirements Engineering）的價值，是幫助團隊避免投入大量努力，做出漂亮卻沒有解決真正問題的系統。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜先理解困難，再選擇解法
blocks.description: 兩欄是平行比喻；共同原則是問題先於解決方案（Problem Before Solution），不是醫療診斷接著軟體開發的流程。

items.title: 醫療診斷
items.body: 病人說：「我要抗生素。」先找出症狀與病因，才決定治療方式。

items.title: 軟體工程
items.body: 使用者說：「我要 AI 系統。」先找出工作困難，才決定是否需要 AI。

sections.heading: 二、用五個問題，把模糊要求變成清楚的問題
paragraphs: 延續課程中的「申請文件收件系統」。有人說：「我想要一個更好用的 AI 收件系統。」這時先不要寫程式，先用五個問題釐清工作。以下是課程合成案例，並非真實訪談發現。
把五個答案整合，可形成初步問題陳述：「收件人員在交接申請文件之前，需要確認必要欄位是否填寫完整。目前透過人工清單檢查，可能存在漏看欄位的情況，造成後續補件。我們希望協助收件人員在交接前辨識並修正缺漏，並透過測試確認改善效果。」其中漏看造成補件的因果關係仍待驗證。
這份問題陳述保留技術選擇的空間：先定義要解決什麼，之後再決定是否使用 AI、建立網站或採用哪種程式語言。

blocks.caption: 圖 2｜Problem Statement Framework｜五個問題
blocks.description: 這五個面向共同定義問題。編號是閱讀與訪談順序，不表示各面向已獲證實。

items.title: 1. Who｜誰遇到問題？
items.body: 負責交接申請文件的收件人員。

items.title: 2. When｜什麼時候發生？
items.body: 在把文件交給下一位同仁之前。

items.title: 3. As-Is｜現在怎麼做？
items.body: 透過人工清單逐一核對必填欄位。

items.title: 4. Problem｜究竟有什麼困難？
items.body: 可能因為漏看欄位，導致文件交接後才需要補件。這是尚待驗證的假設。

items.title: 5. Outcome｜希望改善到什麼程度？
items.body: 讓收件人員在交接之前，就能找到並修正缺漏。

sections.heading: 三、最容易犯的錯：把猜測當成事實
paragraphs: 觀察收件人員時，你看到：「文件類型沒有填寫，但使用者仍然按下匯出。」你可能認為：「使用者一定沒有看懂畫面。」但這個原因還沒有證據；也許他只是測試系統會不會阻止匯出。
把觀察、推論與驗證分開，才知道下一步要查什麼。這也呼應科學研究的順序：觀察現象 → 提出假說 → 設計實驗 → 取得證據 → 修正假說。問題陳述應同時標明已知事實與待驗證的部分。

blocks.caption: 觀察、推論與驗證
rows: 欄位空白，使用者按下匯出
你認為原因可能是什麼
他可能不知道欄位沒有填完整
如何確認猜測是否正確
詢問當時想法，或調整提示後重新測試

sections.heading: 四、什麼叫做「成功」？不能只說效率提高
paragraphs: 要求 AI「做一個可以提升效率的收件系統」，可能得到一套系統，但「看起來很好用」不足以證明成功。驗收至少要分開檢查功能是否遵守規則，以及使用者是否能完成任務。
可能出現程式功能正常，使用者卻不知道怎麼操作的情況。此時技術測試可以全部通過，產品仍未有效解決問題。若要聲稱「效率提升 30%」，必須有改善前的基準資料、改善後的實測資料與合理的比較方法，不能由 AI 編造數字。
NN/G 的介面原則可協助檢查狀態回饋、錯誤預防與修正提示，但目標使用者能否完成工作仍要實際觀察。

blocks.caption: 圖 3｜兩種驗收，各自需要證據
blocks.description: 兩項是平行驗收面向；功能通過不代表使用者驗收通過，也不能直接推得效率提升。

items.title: 功能驗收（Functional Acceptance）
items.body: 確認系統有沒有按照規則運作。例如文件類型空白時，系統必須提示缺漏，並禁止匯出標記為完整的正式報告。

items.title: 使用者驗收（User Acceptance）
items.body: 確認使用者實際能不能完成任務。例如收件人員能找到錯誤提示、知道要補什麼，而且能自行完成修正。

sections.heading: 五、As-Is 與 To-Be：把問題畫成流程
paragraphs: As-Is 是現在實際如何工作，To-Be 是希望未來如何工作。把兩者畫出來，就能看到準備改變哪個環節。本案例把原本人工核對的工作，改為先由系統檢查必填欄位，再由收件人員處理缺漏。
人工核對可能遺漏必填欄位，目前仍是痛點假設；To-Be 也是預期設計。兩張流程的差異說明設計意圖，改善效果要由後續測試確認。有缺漏才進入提示與修正；資料齊全時繼續預覽、匯出與交接。

blocks.caption: 圖 4｜As-Is／To-Be｜比較工作流程
blocks.description: 前 3 格是 As-Is，後 4 格是 To-Be；兩組各自依箭頭前進，沒有從舊流程交接連到新流程填寫的箭頭。To-Be 第 3 格僅於有缺漏時執行。

items.title: As-Is 1｜填寫資料
items.body: 目前流程：輸入申請文件內容。

items.title: As-Is 2｜人工檢查
items.body: 使用人工清單逐一核對。

items.title: As-Is 3｜交接文件
items.body: 假設的痛點：人工核對可能遺漏必填欄位。

items.title: To-Be 1｜填寫資料
items.body: 預期流程：輸入申請文件內容。

items.title: To-Be 2｜系統檢查必填欄位
items.body: 改變的環節：檢查必要欄位是否齊全。

items.title: To-Be 3｜有缺漏就提示並修正
items.body: 條件步驟：有缺漏時顯示提示，修正後確認齊全。

items.title: To-Be 4｜預覽、匯出與交接
items.body: 缺漏處理完成後繼續；改善效果仍待測試。

sections.heading: 六、MVP：第一次不要做一個巨大系統
paragraphs: MVP（Minimum Viable Product）可白話理解為：範圍很小，但能完整走完核心工作，而且足以驗證需求的產品版本。收件系統可以加入 AI、帳號管理、雲端資料庫、權限控制、行動版介面、簽核流程與分析儀表板；第一版先由要驗證的問題決定範圍。
這次最想確認的假設是：「讓收件人員在交接前看到明確的缺漏提示，是否能改善缺漏處理？」只要第一版能測試這件事，就有價值。如果真正的問題是部門之間對必填欄位的定義不一致，就要先整理業務規則；增加 AI 功能未必有幫助。
後續若要使用正式資料、多人帳號或正式簽核，先重新確認規則負責人、角色、資料保存與授權範圍，再決定是否擴大原型。本課的「不含正式部署」指練習產品的範圍。

blocks.caption: 第一版範圍與暫不做清單
rows: AI 自動判斷文件內容

sections.heading: 七、problem.md 與 spec.md 有什麼差別？
paragraphs: 和 M02 的 Coding Agent 接起來：請 AI 協助開發前，準備兩份用途不同、相互銜接的文件。problem.md 說明為什麼需要做；spec.md 說明系統具體要做什麼。
例如 problem.md 寫：「收件人員需要在交接前找出缺漏欄位。」spec.md 寫：「當文件類型欄位為空白時，畫面顯示『請選擇文件類型』，並禁止使用者匯出標記為完整的報告。」前者保留問題與目的，後者把行為與驗收寫清楚。
缺少 problem.md，AI 可能自行假設使用者需求；缺少 spec.md，AI 可能只知道大概目的，不知道具體實作與驗收方式。即使兩份文件齊全，人類仍要檢查規格是否正確，以及實際測試結果是否符合需求。

blocks.caption: 圖 5｜兩份文件的分工
blocks.description: 兩份文件並列比較用途；需求變動時保留原因，並檢查兩份文件是否仍一致。

items.title: problem.md｜問題文件
items.body: 為什麼需要做？誰遇到困難？目前如何工作？想改善什麼？哪些假設還沒證實？

items.title: spec.md｜規格文件
items.body: 系統具體要做什麼？有哪些欄位？如何檢查？錯誤怎麼呈現？如何測試？

blocks.caption: 圖 6｜問題、行為與實作證據的銜接
blocks.description: 箭頭表示工作產物的銜接：problem.md → spec.md → Implementation + Tests；不是自動通過驗收的保證。

items.title: problem.md
items.body: 定義問題。

items.title: spec.md
items.body: 定義行為。

items.title: Implementation + Tests
items.body: 實作程式，執行測試並檢查證據。

sections.heading: 八、實際練習：從零建立一份 problem.md
paragraphs: 下面的精簡示範可複製後修改。十個小節保留使用者、情境、目前流程、困難與狀態、期待結果、MVP、驗收方向、不包含項目、待確認問題及資料來源，讓接手者能追查依據。
文件讓接手者理解系統為什麼存在、哪些事情已確認、哪些仍是假設，以及第一版做到哪裡就足夠。往後訪談或測試有新證據，就保留來源與日期、寫明修改原因，再同步修訂 spec.md。

blocks.heading: problem.md｜十節完整範例
paragraphs: 本範例為課程合成案例，非真實訪談；保留「尚待訪談確認」及不含真實個資的界線。
blocks.code:
# Problem Statement

## 1. 主要使用者
負責交接申請文件的收件人員。

## 2. 工作情境
在把申請文件交給下一位同仁之前，
需要確認必要欄位是否填寫完整。

## 3. 目前流程（As-Is）
收件人員使用人工清單逐項核對。

## 4. 目前困難
假設：人工檢查可能遺漏必填欄位，
導致交接後仍需要補件。

狀態：尚待訪談確認。

## 5. 期待結果
在交接前發現並修正缺漏資料。

## 6. MVP 範圍
- 輸入合成資料
- 檢查必要欄位
- 顯示缺漏提示
- 修正資料
- 預覽及匯出

## 7. 驗收方向
- 欄位缺漏時正確顯示提示
- 缺漏時不能匯出完整報告
- 資料正確時可預覽和匯出
- 試用者能理解提示並完成修正

## 8. 不包含
- 真實個人資料
- 正式業務簽核
- 多人帳號與權限
- 正式部署

## 9. 待確認問題
- 誰負責制定必填欄位規則？
- 漏填是否確實造成補件？
- 使用者最常在哪個步驟遇到困難？

## 10. 資料來源
課程合成案例，非真實訪談。

sections.heading: 九、這堂課如何連到整個軟體工程？
paragraphs: M01 到 M03 形成一條學習主線：先理解軟體工程目的，再理解 AI 協作機制，接著定義要做的工作，最後依規格開發與驗收。
AI 讓產生程式更容易，但判斷應該開發什麼仍需要問題定義。產生程式越容易，團隊也可能越快增加不需要的功能。把模糊想法整理成能訪談、能驗證的問題，能幫助團隊避免投入錯誤方向。

blocks.caption: 圖 7｜從學習目的走向開發與驗收
blocks.description: 這是學習與工作產物的主線；讀完各模組不等於完成實作、使用者驗收或解決問題。

items.title: M01｜理解軟體工程的目的
items.body: 重點是讓使用者完成真正需要的工作，而不只是寫出程式。

items.title: M02｜理解 AI 如何協助完成工作
items.body: 認識 LLM、Context、Tools、Agent Harness、測試與可觀測性。

items.title: M03｜先定義清楚要做的工作
items.body: 將模糊想法變成能訪談、能驗證、能開發的問題與需求。

items.title: 後續開發與驗收
items.body: 依規格實作、測試，並根據證據確認是否解決原本的問題。

sections.heading: 十、理解檢核：換你當需求工程師
paragraphs: 案例：一位主管說：「我們每天整理報表太麻煩了，請幫我做一個 AI 自動報表系統，最好有漂亮的 Dashboard。」請到下方理解檢核作答，逐題比較參考解析。
延伸思考：你最想問這位主管的第一個問題是什麼？先寫下你的追問及理由，再找同儕或教師評改。本站提供參考答案，不會把作答送給教師或自動保存學習成績。
本課核心成果是把「我要一套 AI 系統」轉化成「誰在什麼情境遇到哪個具體問題，以及如何驗證改善效果」。下一課 M03-02 進一步辨認 Stakeholders（利害關係人），了解不同角色對同一項工作可能有不同需求。

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器與合成申請情境；無需真實訪談資料。
steps: 建立 problem.md，先寫角色、時機與困難，將沒有證據的敘述標為假設。
列出 As-Is、To-Be、成功證據與不做清單，保留至少一個待訪談問題。
和同儕交換文件，請他指出一個可以用案例驗證的目標，以及一個仍需追問的原因。
exercise.expected: 得到一份可追問且不預設大型解法的 problem.md。
exercise.check: 若同儕只看文件就能說出誰需要什麼、哪些尚未確認、第一版不做什麼，則初稿可進入下一步。
exercise.cleanup: 保留版本及回饋；刪除誤填的真實姓名、識別碼與業務資料。

readingGuide.goal: 從解法要求中找出尚未被理解的工作問題。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 文字編輯器與合成申請情境；無需真實訪談資料。
readingGuide.route: 先讀原理與例子，再完成最小實作，最後核對理解檢核與參考解析。
readingGuide.output: 得到一份可追問且不預設大型解法的 problem.md。

openChecks.prompt: 你最想問這位主管的第一個問題是什麼？
answer: 可問：「最近一次整理報表時，哪位同仁在哪個步驟遇到什麼困難？能帶我看目前的處理流程嗎？」這能找到具體事件、角色與目前做法，接著分開記錄觀察和推論，再決定還要驗證什麼。這是參考追問，不是唯一正確句型。

en.summary: Turn “build me a system” into a problem statement with a role, difficulty, timing and evidence of success, giving later specifications a clear scope.
objectives: Identify the work problem that a proposed solution leaves unexplained.
Write an observable problem statement that retains uncertainty.
Produce a problem.md draft that a peer can review.

readingGuide.goal: Identify the work problem that a proposed solution leaves unexplained.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A text editor and a synthetic application scenario; no actual interview data is needed.
readingGuide.route: Read the principles and examples, complete the small exercise, then compare your understanding with the checks and reference explanations.
readingGuide.output: A problem.md that supports follow-up questions without assuming a large solution.

sections.heading: Understand the Problem Before Designing a System
paragraphs: When someone asks for a system, first understand the problem they face before designing it. “I want an AI system to improve our work efficiency” sounds like a requirement, but it leaves the actual work unexplained.

Ask whose work needs improvement, what they do each day, which step is difficult, what causes that difficulty, and how improvement would be demonstrated. A Problem Statement organizes these questions into an account that the team can investigate and verify.

sections.heading: 1. Diagnose Before Prescribing: An Analogy for Problem Statements
paragraphs: Imagine a patient saying, “Doctor, I want antibiotics.” Prescribing immediately would skip understanding the symptoms and whether a bacterial infection is involved. A doctor first asks what feels wrong, when it started, what symptoms occur and how severe they are. This analogy illustrates the order of problem definition; it does not make an individual medical assessment.

Software engineering follows the same reasoning. “I want an AI system” expresses an expectation about a solution; the work difficulty still needs investigation. Organizing confusing forms and checking rules might already address it. Requirements Engineering helps teams avoid investing substantial effort in an attractive system that leaves the real problem unresolved.

blocks.caption: Figure 1｜Understand the Difficulty Before Choosing a Solution
blocks.description: The columns are parallel analogies sharing Problem Before Solution. They do not form a medical-to-software sequence.

items.title: Medical diagnosis
items.body: The patient says, “I want antibiotics.” Understand symptoms and causes before choosing treatment.

items.title: Software engineering
items.body: The user says, “I want an AI system.” Understand the work difficulty before deciding whether AI is needed.

sections.heading: 2. Turn a Vague Request into a Clear Problem with Five Questions
paragraphs: Continue the course’s application-document intake scenario. Someone asks for “a better AI intake system.” Before coding, use five questions to clarify the work. This is a synthetic teaching scenario, not a finding from actual interviews.

Combine the answers into a draft: “Before handing over application documents, intake workers need to check required fields for completeness. Manual checklist review may overlook fields and lead to later requests for missing information. We aim to help workers identify and correct omissions before handoff, and test whether this improves the work.” The causal link between overlooked fields and later requests still needs verification.
This statement leaves technology choices open. Define what needs to be solved before deciding whether to use AI, build a website or choose a programming language.

blocks.caption: Figure 2｜Problem Statement Framework | Five Questions
blocks.description: These five dimensions jointly define the problem. Numbers guide reading and interviews; they do not establish the answers as verified facts.

items.title: 1. Who | Who faces the problem?
items.body: Intake workers responsible for handing over application documents.

items.title: 2. When | When does it occur?
items.body: Before handing the documents to the next colleague.

items.title: 3. As-Is | How is it done now?
items.body: Check required fields one by one with a manual checklist.

items.title: 4. Problem | What is difficult?
items.body: Overlooked fields may cause requests for missing information after handoff. This is an unverified assumption.

items.title: 5. Outcome | What should improve?
items.body: Enable intake workers to find and correct omissions before handoff.

sections.heading: 3. Avoid Treating a Guess as a Fact
paragraphs: You observe that document type is blank but the user still presses Export. You might conclude that the user did not understand the screen. That explanation lacks evidence: the person might simply be testing whether the system blocks export.

Separating observation, inference and validation makes the next investigation clear. This resembles scientific inquiry: observe a phenomenon, propose a hypothesis, design an experiment, obtain evidence and revise the hypothesis. A problem statement should identify both known facts and points that still need validation.

blocks.caption: Observation, Inference and Validation
rows: The field is blank and the user presses Export.
They may not know the field is incomplete.
Ask what they were thinking, or revise the feedback and test again.

sections.heading: 4. Define Success with Evidence Beyond “Improved Efficiency”
paragraphs: Asking AI for an intake system that improves efficiency may produce a system, but “it looks useful” is insufficient evidence of success. Acceptance should check separately whether functions follow the rules and whether users can complete the task.

Functions can work correctly while users cannot work out how to operate them. Technical tests may all pass while the product leaves the problem unresolved. A claim of “30% greater efficiency” requires baseline data, measurements after the change and a reasonable comparison method; AI must not invent the number.
NN/G’s interface principles can help inspect status feedback, error prevention and recovery guidance. Whether the intended users can complete their work still requires direct observation.

blocks.caption: Figure 3｜Two Types of Acceptance Need Their Own Evidence
blocks.description: These are parallel acceptance dimensions. Passing functional tests establishes neither user acceptance nor an efficiency gain.

items.title: Functional Acceptance
items.body: Check that the system follows its rules. If document type is blank, it must report the omission and prevent export of an official report marked complete.

items.title: User Acceptance
items.body: Check whether users can actually complete the task. An intake worker should find the error message, understand what is missing and make the correction independently.

sections.heading: 5. Map the Current and Intended Workflows
paragraphs: As-Is describes how work is currently done. To-Be describes the intended future workflow. Drawing both exposes the step being changed: the example replaces manual checking with a system check of required fields, followed by the intake worker’s correction of omissions.

The risk that manual review overlooks required fields remains a pain-point assumption, and To-Be remains a proposed design. The difference explains the intended change; later tests must establish its effect. Prompting and correction apply when omissions exist. Complete data proceeds to preview, export and handoff.

blocks.caption: Figure 4｜As-Is / To-Be | Compare Workflows
blocks.description: The first 3 nodes form As-Is and the last 4 form To-Be. Arrows stay within each group; no arrow connects old handoff to new input. To-Be node 3 applies only when omissions exist.

items.title: As-Is 1 | Enter data
items.body: Current workflow: enter the application-document data.

items.title: As-Is 2 | Check manually
items.body: Review the data using a manual checklist.

items.title: As-Is 3 | Hand over documents
items.body: Assumed pain point: manual checking may overlook required fields.

items.title: To-Be 1 | Enter data
items.body: Intended workflow: enter the application-document data.

items.title: To-Be 2 | Check required fields
items.body: Changed step: check whether required fields are complete.

items.title: To-Be 3 | Prompt and correct omissions
items.body: Conditional step: show omissions and verify completeness after correction.

items.title: To-Be 4 | Preview, export and handoff
items.body: Continue after omissions are resolved; improvement still requires testing.

sections.heading: 6. MVP: Start with a Small Complete Product
paragraphs: An MVP (Minimum Viable Product) is a small version that completes the core work and is sufficient to test the need. An intake system could include AI, accounts, a cloud database, permissions, a mobile interface, approvals and dashboards. The question to test determines the first version’s scope.

The central assumption is: “Does showing clear missing-field feedback before handoff improve how intake workers handle omissions?” A first version that can test this question is useful. If departments instead disagree about which fields are required, first reconcile the business rules; more AI functionality may not help.

Before introducing real business data, shared accounts or official approvals, reconfirm rule ownership, roles, retention and authorization, then decide whether to expand the prototype. “No production deployment” below describes the scope of the exercise product.

sections.heading: 7. How problem.md and spec.md Differ
paragraphs: Connect this to Coding Agents in M02: before asking AI to develop software, prepare two documents with different, connected purposes. problem.md explains why the work is needed; spec.md describes the required system behavior.

For example, problem.md says, “Intake workers need to find missing fields before handoff.” spec.md says, “When document type is blank, display ‘請選擇文件類型’ (Please select a document type) and prevent export of a report marked complete.” The former states the problem and purpose; the latter makes behavior and acceptance explicit.

Without problem.md, AI may invent user needs. Without spec.md, it may understand the general goal but lack concrete implementation and acceptance rules. Even with both documents, people must review the specification and verify that actual test results meet the need.

blocks.caption: Figure 5｜Two Documents, Different Responsibilities
blocks.description: Compare their purposes side by side. Record the reason for requirement changes and keep both documents consistent.

items.title: problem.md | Problem document
items.body: Why do this? Who faces difficulty? How is work done now? What should improve? Which assumptions remain unverified?

items.title: spec.md | Specification document
items.body: What exactly should the system do? Which fields are required? How are they checked? How are errors shown? How will behavior be tested?

blocks.caption: Figure 6｜Connect the Problem, Behavior and Implementation Evidence
blocks.description: Arrows connect work artifacts: problem.md → spec.md → Implementation + Tests. They do not guarantee acceptance.

items.title: problem.md
items.body: Define the problem.

items.title: spec.md
items.body: Define behavior.

items.title: Implementation + Tests
items.body: Implement the code, run tests and inspect the evidence.

sections.heading: 8. Build a problem.md from Scratch
paragraphs: Copy and adapt the concise example below. Its ten subsections retain the user, context, current process, difficulty and status, intended outcome, MVP, acceptance directions, exclusions, unresolved questions and source, so another person can trace its basis.

The document helps the next person understand why the system exists, what is confirmed, what remains assumed and where the first version ends. When interviews or tests yield new evidence, retain its source and date, explain the revision and update spec.md accordingly.

blocks.heading: problem.md | Complete Ten-Section Example
paragraphs: This shared Traditional Chinese artifact is a synthetic course example, not an interview finding. Its ten sections specify: the intake worker; checking required fields before handoff; a manual checklist; possible omissions and later requests, pending interviews; finding and correcting omissions before handoff; synthetic input, checks, feedback, correction, preview and export; correct feedback, blocked incomplete exports, successful complete exports and understandable correction; no personal data, official approvals, shared accounts or production deployment; rule ownership, the link to later requests and difficult steps; and the synthetic source. The unverified status remains explicit.
blocks.code:
# Problem Statement

## 1. 主要使用者
負責交接申請文件的收件人員。

## 2. 工作情境
在把申請文件交給下一位同仁之前，
需要確認必要欄位是否填寫完整。

## 3. 目前流程（As-Is）
收件人員使用人工清單逐項核對。

## 4. 目前困難
假設：人工檢查可能遺漏必填欄位，
導致交接後仍需要補件。

狀態：尚待訪談確認。

## 5. 期待結果
在交接前發現並修正缺漏資料。

## 6. MVP 範圍
- 輸入合成資料
- 檢查必要欄位
- 顯示缺漏提示
- 修正資料
- 預覽及匯出

## 7. 驗收方向
- 欄位缺漏時正確顯示提示
- 缺漏時不能匯出完整報告
- 資料正確時可預覽和匯出
- 試用者能理解提示並完成修正

## 8. 不包含
- 真實個人資料
- 正式業務簽核
- 多人帳號與權限
- 正式部署

## 9. 待確認問題
- 誰負責制定必填欄位規則？
- 漏填是否確實造成補件？
- 使用者最常在哪個步驟遇到困難？

## 10. 資料來源
課程合成案例，非真實訪談。

sections.heading: 9. Connect This Lesson to the Engineering Process
paragraphs: M01 through M03 form a learning route: understand the purpose of software engineering, understand AI collaboration, define the work, and then develop and accept it against specifications.

AI makes generating code easier, while deciding what to develop still requires problem definition. Easy code generation can also accelerate the addition of unnecessary features. Turning vague ideas into problems that interviews and tests can investigate helps teams avoid investing in the wrong direction.

blocks.caption: Figure 7｜From Engineering Purpose to Development and Acceptance
blocks.description: This is a learning and artifact-development route. Reading the modules does not establish implementation, user acceptance or resolution of the problem.

items.title: M01 | Understand the purpose of software engineering
items.body: Help users complete the work they actually need, beyond merely producing code.

items.title: M02 | Understand how AI assists work
items.body: Learn about LLMs, Context, Tools, Agent Harness, testing and observability.

items.title: M03 | Define the work clearly
items.body: Turn vague ideas into problems and requirements that can be investigated, verified and developed.

items.title: Later development and acceptance
items.body: Implement and test against specifications, then use evidence to check whether the original problem is resolved.

sections.heading: 10. Understanding Check: Act as a Requirements Engineer
paragraphs: Scenario: a manager says, “Preparing daily reports is too much trouble. Please build an AI reporting system, preferably with an attractive Dashboard.” Answer the understanding checks below and compare each response with the reference explanations.

Reflection: what is the first question you would ask this manager? Write the question and your reason, then ask a peer or teacher for feedback. This site provides reference answers; it does not send answers to a teacher or automatically save learning scores.

The core outcome is to turn “I want an AI system” into an account of who faces which specific problem, in what situation, and how improvement will be verified. M03-02 then identifies Stakeholders and examines how different roles may need different things from the same work.

exercise.environment: A text editor and synthetic application scenario; no actual interview data is needed.
steps: Create problem.md with a role, timing and difficulty. Label statements without evidence as assumptions.
Add As-Is, To-Be, success evidence and exclusions, retaining at least one interview question.
Exchange documents with a peer. Ask them to identify one goal that cases can verify and one cause that still needs investigation.
exercise.expected: A problem.md that supports follow-up questions without assuming a large solution.
exercise.check: The draft can proceed when a peer can identify who needs what, what remains unconfirmed and what the first version excludes from the document alone.
exercise.cleanup: Keep versions and feedback. Remove any real names, identifiers or business data entered by mistake.

openChecks.prompt: What is the first question you would ask this manager?
answer: For example: “The last time a report was prepared, who encountered what difficulty, at which step? Can you show me the current process?” This seeks a concrete event, role and workflow. Separate observations from inferences, then decide what needs verification. This is a reference question, not the only correct wording.

options: 先問清楚誰在整理、哪個步驟困難、目前流程如何運作
立刻請 AI 產生 Dashboard
先挑選準確率最高的 LLM
rationales: 角色、困難與目前流程能幫助團隊定義可驗證的問題。
畫面產生速度無法確認它是否解決工作困難。
模型選擇需要已釐清的任務與驗收標準。

options: Ask who prepares reports, which step is difficult and how the current process works.
Immediately ask AI to generate a Dashboard.
First choose the most accurate LLM.
rationales: Roles, difficulties and the current process help define a problem that can be verified.
Generating a screen quickly does not establish that it addresses the work difficulty.
Model selection needs a defined task and acceptance criteria.

zh.prompt: 主管說「大家都覺得報表很難整理」，你應該如何記錄？
options: 已經證實所有同仁都有相同困難
主管的說法是一項待查證的線索，需要訪談與觀察
代表系統必須使用 AI
rationales: 一位主管的說法不能直接代表所有同仁的經驗。
保留回報來源與待查證狀態，才能規劃訪談與觀察。
困難的回報還沒有決定應採用哪一種技術。

en.prompt: How should you record the manager’s claim that everyone finds reports difficult?
options: It is established that all colleagues face the same difficulty.
The manager’s statement is a lead to check through interviews and observation.
The system must therefore use AI.
rationales: One manager’s statement does not establish every colleague’s experience.
Retaining the source and unverified status supports further interviews and observation.
A report of difficulty does not determine the appropriate technology.

zh.prompt: 第一版系統應該怎麼決定範圍？
options: 把 Dashboard、AI、自動化、多部門權限一次完成
先找出核心困難，做足以驗證的最小完整流程
只做漂亮畫面即可，不需要測試
rationales: 功能越多，越可能在驗證核心問題前投入大量工作。
最小完整流程能讓團隊取得判斷假設的證據。
外觀不能代替功能測試與使用者任務觀察。

en.prompt: How should you choose the first version’s scope?
options: Build the Dashboard, AI, automation and cross-department permissions all at once.
Identify the core difficulty and build the smallest complete workflow sufficient to test it.
Build an attractive screen without testing.
rationales: More features can consume effort before the core problem is verified.
A small complete workflow yields evidence for evaluating the assumption.
Appearance cannot replace functional tests and observation of user tasks.
